summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on the effective detection range for 2D lidars. Initially, one participant suggested a range of 30 meters, while another referenced a specification stating the system can perform a 2D 360-degree scan within a 40-meter range.

This discrepancy led to a discussion about adjusting zones if the stated specifications were accurate and applied to a single location. The participants concluded that no changes should be made to the current setup for now.
decisions: No immediate changes are required for zone settings.
